content: We need to determine number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of the molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect carbonyl stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use IR tool first (cheapest). Then interpret presence of C=O stretch (~1700 cm-1). Could also use carbon NMR to see peaks in carbonyl region. Let's get IR.
